DMR report: dss_gse95654_20m_20261023-141329

Tumor against matched normal in 9 patients (18 samples), tested with DSS (Dispersion Shrinkage for Sequencing data). The model is ~ patient + tissue: each tumor is compared with its own patient's normal, so differences between patients, including read layout, drop out of the test.

718,148CpG sites tested, 5+ reads in all
168,747sites at FDR < 0.05 (45,445 up, 123,302 down in tumor)
10,947DMRs (2,604 up, 8,343 down)

Volcano

Each point is one CpG (cytosine followed by guanine) site. Left and right is the change in mean beta (methylated reads over total reads) from normal to tumor; up is stronger evidence. Colored points pass FDR (false discovery rate) < 0.05, meaning about 5% of them are expected to be false calls. To keep the page light, it shows a random 8,000 of 45,445 sites higher in tumor, 8,000 of 123,302 lower in tumor, 8,000 of 549,401 not significant. volcano.png plots every site.

DMRs (differentially methylated regions)

Runs of at least 3 nearby FDR (false discovery rate)-significant sites. Area statistic is the sum of the sites' test statistics: its size ranks the regions, its sign gives the direction. Showing the 500 strongest of 10,947. Click a column header to sort, or a row to plot it below.
